description: Release artifact naming (ADR-048 DEC-3.8, DEC-8.5, DEC-28). The Suderra OS channel ships one artifact per (board_profile, arch) from boards.json with its DSSE release statement beside it; the generic-Linux channel keeps its frozen names. Release workflow, cloud manifest builder, root installer and agent all derive names from here.
